_comment: Filter configuration for extract.py skill verification gate
_usage: Use --verify-evidence flag to enable post-extraction filtering
_design_note: Filters ALWAYS run post-extraction to maximize skill extraction before filtering

filters.name: direct_evidence_check
filters.description: Check if skill is directly supported by resume evidence (not just inferred)
filters.user_prompt_template:
Does the resume contain DIRECT evidence that the candidate has the skill "{skill}"?

Direct evidence means:
- Explicit mention of the skill/technology/tool by name
- Clear description of using or working with this specific skill
- Projects, tasks, or responsibilities that explicitly involve this skill

NOT direct evidence:
- Skills that could be inferred but aren't explicitly mentioned
- General statements that might imply the skill
- Related skills that aren't the same thing

Respond with ONLY "YES" if there is direct evidence, or "NO" if the skill is only inferred.
